title.description: The page's title, 20px bold on one line that ends in an ellipsis; the runtime API also accepts a template-only snippet.

titleVisible.description:
Draws the title. Bind a large PageHeader's `collapsed` here so the title appears once the large
title scrolls away; while it is hidden the title is also hidden from assistive technology.

headingLevel.description:
Makes the title the page's heading at this level, for a page whose identity lives in the bar.
Leave it unset when a PageHeader carries the page's heading.

unsupportedProps.name: leading
unsupportedProps.description: Content at the start of the bar, after Back.

unsupportedProps.name: trailing
unsupportedProps.description: Content at the end of the bar, before the icon actions.
